reviews.specification:
General operation: bounded food foraging, parameterized for any applicable actor by origin, radius, maximum path length, elapsed-round limit, energy-spend limit, quantity/meal cap, eating reserve, personal evidenceRefs, recheck/exploration options, avoided areas/directions, and health/temperature stops. This is a serial controller, not a new food source or a safety oracle. Record implementation dependencies and code reuse explicitly: bounded-resource-search-low-health, bounded-resource-search-recheck, bounded-resource-search, assess-food-suitability, navigate, probe, gather and eat. Reuse the safety evidence evaluator internally; any separately executed assessment must retain its existing learning requirement. Do not grant those learned interfaces or individual mastery through registration. Any unavailable internal dependency or incompatible schema is an implementation task in this handoff, not grounds for permanent rejection.
Prerequisites: a living actor able to perform the underlying actions, applicable personal food evidence, and real reachable targets for any physical interaction. No tool or food is supplied. Accept exact personal record keys or evidence-event IDs; for Lin, the supplied personal record key berry supports the recorded nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 only to the extent allowed by the existing eating-evidence evaluator. The old commons-berry-1-0:observed-state record at tick 15 is a remembered destination/observation, not proof of present stock. Validate record type and applicability in code before consuming. Names, mature stage and visual labels alone establish neither identity nor safety. Root, hazelnut and acorn safety remain unresolved on these facts.
Execution: assemble eligible food kinds from applicable personal eating evidence, not a hidden global edible list. Consider actually observed or personally remembered sources inside the bounds; prefer currently observed ripe eligible sources, then bounded rechecks of remembered/observed empty sources if enabled. Use the inherited nearest-reach policy and real path feasibility across all eligible kinds rather than completing one resource search first. Recheck each empty source at most once per run. Remembered sources supply destinations only; probe in reach supplies current observations. Unknown observed food candidates may be reported as safety unresolved, never sampled by eating or presumed safe. Exploration is optional and limited to feasible observed traversable dry ground that can reveal new surroundings, without hidden-stock selection or entering avoided regions. Skip candidates whose verified action chain cannot fit the remaining budgets; stop when no feasible candidate or exploration step remains. All currently supplied visible food stocks are zero; branches and vines are not substitute food.
On finding a currently supported ripe source, gather one supported edible unit, then make consuming that owned unit the next action before any further search or gathering. Revalidate safety, ownership and action feasibility at consumption. At most one ordinary primitive is scheduled per controller round, and its real duration is not shortened. An existing eligible owned unit may likewise be eaten first. Stop at the requested bounded intake/quantity cap or chosen satiety target; never force consumption after the actor stops. No automatic preparation, detoxification, gifting, participation by others or access to another actor's property is implied.
Costs and conservation: the controller adds no material or energy surcharge. Navigate costs actual distance times 2 energy, with existing ground/load modifiers and speed limit 0.8 per round; probe observation costs 1 round and 0.2 energy; gather costs 1 round and 2 energy per unit and subtracts exactly the transferred units from finite current source stock; eat costs 1 energy and consumes actual owned food under its existing nutrition/toxicity rules. Eating receives a serialized action slot and cannot be made instantaneous by this wrapper; retain any longer primitive duration. Assessment trials are unnecessary for the smallest version and are not run automatically. Study takes 1 round, zero added energy or material, with ordinary world physiology still applying. Review/development waiting advances no time. Before every step, quote its actual cost and reserve at least 1 energy for eating, or the larger actor-specified reserve; before gathering, budget the complete gather-and-eat pair. No credit for speculative food, future energy recovery or unperformed actions. Maintain separate gross energy spent, elapsed rounds, path traveled, gathered units and consumed nutrition. No free stock, healing, replenishment or canceled-action refund; actual toxicity remains possible if evidence proves imperfect. Basic nutrition follows eat, not mood.
Emergency behavior: inherit the low-health search rule so low satiety and starvation damage alone do not veto a bounded attempt. Use explicit minHealth in the existing range 20–100, default 60, and stop at or below it; stop for non-starvation injury in the preceding round, temperature at or below 12 or at or above 32, or stricter caller thresholds. Budget, reach, safety and reserve failures also stop. Lin's supplied health 92, energy 9.89056216 and temperature 28.5134988 do not alone bar an attempt, but do not establish an affordable route, food, or future survival. Evaluate actual vitals again after study and before every physical action.
Progress and lifecycle: keep one bounded run record with exact actor/target/source/item IDs, evidence references, current phase, visited sources, action outcomes, original start tick, limits and remaining budgets. Another action pauses the controller; resume rechecks life, safety, stock, ownership, position and budgets rather than replaying completed work. Elapsed time includes paused rounds as in the reused search engine. Cancel, death, exhausted limits or a hard stop ends scheduling immediately. Completed travel/observations remain real, gathered but uneaten food remains in actual inventory subject to ordinary ownership/death rules, and consumed food stays consumed. Refund no elapsed time, spent energy, used material or lost food; release only unspent reservations. There is no background searching, automatic resting, repeated regrowth polling or maintenance beyond action-time validation. Normal world growth and physiology continue only during actual advancing rounds. Completion reports consumed/gathered quantities, traveled distance, expenditure, observed stock, unresolved safety and the exact stopping reason, including an honest zero-food result. Implement established transitions and checks in code, not recurring model review.
